title: Set Seedance to v2.5 with a 30-second duration and 16:9 aspect ratio for this…
content:
Set Seedance to v2.5 with a 30-second duration and 16:9 aspect ratio for this single-shot sequence.

Enforce a single continuous first-person POV by explicitly prompting ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY and stating ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot for the full duration.

Prevent unwanted perspective changes by adding hard negatives like NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, and ZERO POV switches.

Specify the POV lens and framing to stabilize the look: clean 0.5× ultra-wide 13mm-equivalent first-person camera at natural human eye level.

Eliminate VR/goggle artifacts by explicitly prompting CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE and adding negatives for black circular border, goggle/glasses effect, helmet rim, artificial lens frame, tunnel vision, and visible camera housing.

Maintain body/prop continuity in POV by listing persistent on-screen elements (bronze scale armor, shield in left hand, spear in right hand, wrist guards, sandaled legs) and instructing they remain visually consistent throughout.

Lock character consistency by explicitly stating EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD and adding negatives to prevent a second guard/duplicate armor.

Lock key character design details (e.g., Polyphemus has exactly ONE centered forehead eye) and add negatives to prevent multiple eyes, glowing eye, or changing proportions.

Use a storyboarded, timestamped beat sheet (0–4s, 4–7s, etc.) to control actions and camera motion while reiterating Still first-person / No camera cut at each segment.

Tie camera motion to physical actions to reduce drift: breathing causes subtle movement, falling makes the same camera tumble, standing makes the same camera rise, running makes the same camera bounce, looking back rotates the same camera.

Add a comprehensive negative prompt to prevent edits and artifacts: no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks.

es.content:
Configura Seedance en v2.5 con una duración de 30 segundos y una relación de aspecto 16:9 para esta secuencia de una sola toma.

Impón una única POV en primera persona continua mediante un prompt explícito de ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY y especificando ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot durante toda la duración.

Evita cambios de perspectiva no deseados añadiendo negativos contundentes como NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, y ZERO POV switches.

Especifica la lente y el encuadre de POV para estabilizar el aspecto: cámara en primera persona ultra gran angular limpia de 0.5× equivalente a 13 mm, a la altura natural de los ojos humanos.

Elimina artefactos de VR/gafas mediante un prompt explícito de CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE y añadiendo negativos para black circular border, goggle/glasses effect, helmet rim, artificial lens frame, tunnel vision, y visible camera housing.

Mantén la continuidad del cuerpo/props en POV enumerando elementos persistentes en pantalla (bronze scale armor, shield in left hand, spear in right hand, wrist guards, sandaled legs) e indicando que permanezcan visualmente consistentes durante toda la secuencia.

Bloquea la consistencia del personaje indicando explícitamente EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD y añadiendo negativos para evitar un segundo guardia/duplicate armor.

Bloquea los detalles clave del diseño del personaje (por ejemplo, Polyphemus has exactly ONE centered forehead eye) y añade negativos para evitar multiple eyes, glowing eye, o changing proportions.

Usa una hoja de beats tipo storyboard con marcas de tiempo (0–4s, 4–7s, etc.) para controlar las acciones y el movimiento de cámara, reiterando Still first-person / No camera cut en cada segmento.

Vincula el movimiento de cámara a acciones físicas para reducir el drift: breathing causes subtle movement, falling makes the same camera tumble, standing makes the same camera rise, running makes the same camera bounce, looking back rotates the same camera.

Añade un negative prompt completo para evitar ediciones y artefactos: no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks.

fr.content:
Réglez Seedance sur v2.5 avec une durée de 30 secondes et un format d’image 16:9 pour cette séquence en un seul plan.

Imposez un POV à la première personne unique et continu en indiquant explicitement ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY et en précisant ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot pour toute la durée.

Empêchez les changements de perspective indésirables en ajoutant des négatifs stricts comme NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, et ZERO POV switches.

Précisez l’objectif POV et le cadrage pour stabiliser le rendu : caméra à la première personne ultra-large 0.5× propre, équivalent 13 mm, à hauteur naturelle des yeux humains.

Éliminez les artefacts VR/lunettes en indiquant explicitement CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE et en ajoutant des négatifs pour bord circulaire noir, effet lunettes/casque, rebord de casque, cadre d’objectif artificiel, vision en tunnel et boîtier de caméra visible.

Maintenez la continuité du corps et des accessoires en POV en listant les éléments persistants à l’écran (armure d’écailles en bronze, bouclier dans la main gauche, lance dans la main droite, protège-poignets, jambes sandalisées) et en demandant qu’ils restent visuellement cohérents tout au long de la séquence.

Verrouillez la cohérence du personnage en indiquant explicitement EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD et en ajoutant des négatifs pour empêcher un deuxième garde / une armure dupliquée.

Verrouillez les détails clés du design du personnage (par ex., Polyphemus a exactement ONE centered forehead eye) et ajoutez des négatifs pour empêcher plusieurs yeux, un œil lumineux ou des proportions changeantes.

Utilisez une feuille de rythme scénarisée et horodatée (0–4 s, 4–7 s, etc.) pour contrôler les actions et le mouvement de caméra tout en réitérant Still first-person / No camera cut à chaque segment.

Reliez le mouvement de caméra aux actions physiques pour réduire la dérive : la respiration provoque un léger mouvement, la chute fait basculer la même caméra, le fait de se lever fait monter la même caméra, courir fait rebondir la même caméra, regarder en arrière fait pivoter la même caméra.

Ajoutez un negative prompt complet pour empêcher les montages et les artefacts : no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks.

ja.content:
Seedance を v2.5 に設定し、この単一ショットのシーケンスは 30 秒の尺、アスペクト比 16:9 にしてください。

全編を通して単一の連続した一人称 POV を厳守するため、ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY と明示的にプロンプトし、さらに全尺にわたって ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot と記述してください。

望まない視点変化を防ぐため、NEVER show the guard from outside、NEVER switch to third person、NEVER over-the-shoulder、ZERO POV switches などの強いネガティブ指定を追加してください。

見た目を安定させるため、POV レンズとフレーミングを指定します。自然な人間の目線に合わせた、クリーンな 0.5× の超広角 13mm 相当の一人称カメラにしてください。

VR / ゴーグル由来のアーティファクトを排除するため、CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE と明示的にプロンプトし、黒い円形の縁、ゴーグル／眼鏡のような効果、ヘルメットの縁、人工的なレンズフレーム、トンネル視野、見えるカメラハウジングをネガティブ指定に含めてください。

POV 内の身体／小道具の連続性を保つため、画面内に常に見える要素（青銅の鱗状鎧、左手の盾、右手の槍、手首の防具、サンダルを履いた脚）を列挙し、全体を通して視覚的に一貫しているよう指示してください。

キャラクターの一貫性を固定するため、EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD と明示し、2 人目の衛兵や複製された鎧を防ぐネガティブ指定を追加してください。

主要キャラクターデザインの詳細を固定します（例: Polyphemus は額の中央にある目がちょうど 1 つ）。複数の目、発光する目、変化する体型を防ぐネガティブ指定も追加してください。

ストーリーボード化したタイムスタンプ付きのビートシート（0–4 秒、4–7 秒など）を使って、各区間で Still first-person / No camera cut を繰り返しながら、アクションとカメラの動きを制御してください。

カメラの動きを身体の動作に結びつけてドリフトを減らします。呼吸でわずかに揺れ、倒れると同じカメラが回転し、立ち上がると同じカメラが上昇し、走ると同じカメラが揺れ、振り返ると同じカメラが回転するようにしてください。

編集やアーティファクトを防ぐため、包括的なネガティブプロンプトを追加してください。no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks。

ko.content:
Seedance를 v2.5로 설정하고, 이 단일 숏 시퀀스에 대해 30초 길이와 16:9 화면 비율을 사용하세요.

ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY를 명시적으로 프롬프트에 넣고, 전체 길이에 걸쳐 ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot이라고 분명히 적어, 단일하고 연속적인 1인칭 시점을 강제하세요.

NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, ZERO POV switches 같은 하드 네거티브를 추가해 원치 않는 시점 변화를 방지하세요.

보이는 느낌을 안정화하기 위해 POV 렌즈와 프레이밍을 지정하세요: 자연스러운 인간 눈높이의 깨끗한 0.5× 초광각 13mm 상당 1인칭 카메라.

CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE를 명시적으로 프롬프트에 넣고, 검은 원형 테두리, 고글/안경 효과, 헬멧 테두리, 인공적인 렌즈 프레임, 터널 비전, 보이는 카메라 하우징에 대한 네거티브를 추가해 VR/고글 아티팩트를 제거하세요.

POV에서 신체/소품의 연속성을 유지하기 위해 지속적으로 화면에 보이는 요소들(청동 비늘 갑옷, 왼손의 방패, 오른손의 창, 손목 보호대, 샌들을 신은 다리)을 나열하고, 이 요소들이 전체 내내 시각적으로 일관되게 유지되도록 지시하세요.

EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD라고 명시적으로 적어 캐릭터 일관성을 고정하고, 두 번째 경비병/복제된 갑옷을 방지하는 네거티브를 추가하세요.

Polyphemus는 정확히 ONE centered forehead eye를 가진다는 식으로 핵심 캐릭터 디자인 디테일을 고정하고, 여러 개의 눈, 빛나는 눈, 변하는 비율을 방지하는 네거티브를 추가하세요.

스토리보드 형식의 타임스탬프 비트 시트(0–4s, 4–7s 등)를 사용해 동작과 카메라 움직임을 제어하면서, 각 구간마다 Still first-person / No camera cut을 반복하세요.

카메라 움직임을 물리적 동작에 연결해 드리프트를 줄이세요: 숨을 쉬면 미세하게 움직이고, 넘어지면 같은 카메라가 함께 굴러가며, 일어서면 같은 카메라가 올라가고, 달리면 같은 카메라가 흔들리고, 뒤를 돌아보면 같은 카메라가 회전합니다.

편집과 아티팩트를 방지하기 위해 포괄적인 네거티브 프롬프트를 추가하세요: no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks.

pt.content:
Defina o Seedance para v2.5 com duração de 30 segundos e proporção de 16:9 para esta sequência em plano único.

Imponha uma POV de primeira pessoa única e contínua, usando explicitamente o prompt ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY e declarando ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot durante toda a duração.

Evite mudanças indesejadas de perspectiva adicionando negativas rígidas como NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, e ZERO POV switches.

Especifique a lente e o enquadramento da POV para estabilizar o visual: câmera de primeira pessoa limpa, ultra-wide 0.5× equivalente a 13mm, na altura natural dos olhos humanos.

Elimine artefatos de VR/óculos com o prompt explícito CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE e adicionando negativas para borda circular preta, efeito de óculos/visor, aro do capacete, moldura artificial da lente, visão em túnel e housing da câmera visível.

Mantenha a continuidade do corpo/props na POV listando elementos persistentes na tela (armadura de escamas bronze, escudo na mão esquerda, lança na mão direita, protetores de pulso, pernas com sandálias) e instruindo que permaneçam visualmente consistentes o tempo todo.

Trave a consistência do personagem declarando explicitamente EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD e adicionando negativas para impedir um segundo guarda/armadura duplicada.

Trave os detalhes-chave do design do personagem (por exemplo, Polyphemus tem exatamente ONE centered forehead eye) e adicione negativas para impedir múltiplos olhos, olho brilhante ou proporções variáveis.

Use uma beat sheet em estilo storyboard, com timestamps (0–4s, 4–7s, etc.), para controlar as ações e o movimento da câmera, reiterando Still first-person / No camera cut em cada segmento.

Vincule o movimento da câmera às ações físicas para reduzir deriva: respirar causa movimento sutil, cair faz a mesma câmera girar, levantar faz a mesma câmera subir, correr faz a mesma câmera quicar, olhar para trás gira a mesma câmera.

Adicione um negative prompt abrangente para evitar edições e artefatos: no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks.

zh.content:
将 Seedance 设置为 v2.5，时长 30 秒，画幅比例 16:9，用于这个单镜头序列。

通过明确提示 ABSOLUTE CAMERA LOCK / HIGHEST PRIORITY，并声明整段时长都为 ONE CONTINUOUS FIRST-PERSON POV shot，来强制保持单一连续的第一人称视角。

通过添加强硬的负面约束来防止不必要的视角变化，例如 NEVER show the guard from outside, NEVER switch to third person, NEVER over-the-shoulder, and ZERO POV switches。

指定 POV 镜头与构图以稳定画面效果：clean 0.5× ultra-wide 13mm-equivalent first-person camera at natural human eye level。

通过明确提示 CLEAN POV — NO VIGNETTE，并添加针对 black circular border, goggle/glasses effect, helmet rim, artificial lens frame, tunnel vision, and visible camera housing 的负面约束，消除 VR/护目镜伪影。

通过列出持续出现在画面中的元素（bronze scale armor, shield in left hand, spear in right hand, wrist guards, sandaled legs），并指示它们在整个过程中保持视觉一致，来维持第一人称中的身体/道具连续性。

通过明确声明 EXACTLY ONE POV GUARD，并添加负面约束以防止出现第二个 guard/duplicate armor，来锁定角色一致性。

锁定关键角色设计细节（例如，Polyphemus has exactly ONE centered forehead eye），并添加负面约束以防止 multiple eyes, glowing eye, or changing proportions。

使用分镜化、带时间戳的节拍表（0–4s, 4–7s, etc.）来控制动作和镜头运动，同时在每个片段重复强调 Still first-person / No camera cut。

将镜头运动与身体动作绑定，以减少漂移：breathing causes subtle movement, falling makes the same camera tumble, standing makes the same camera rise, running makes the same camera bounce, looking back rotates the same camera。

添加一份全面的负面提示词，以防止剪辑和伪影：no cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no time skips, no teleportation, no subtitles/text/logos/watermarks。
